title: Use a clear type
summary: Go: Use a clear type. Change the score to 9.
introduction: A type says what kind of value fits a variable. int stores whole numbers.
learningObjectives: Use a clear type with Go

blocks.text: Install Go 1.22 or later. Save one complete example as lesson.go and run go run lesson.go.

blocks.title: Use a clear type

blocks.text: The declaration gives score type int and value 8. Println reads that value.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: An int cannot store text like "eight".
